text: A filler letter is a letter Sanborn might have scattered through the message to be ignored. Striking it out shifts every later place, so BERLINCLOCK lands earlier.
Every letter, and every pair of letters, was tried as the filler, struck everywhere outside the two known stretches: 351 choices, then the usual repeating-key test under every length.
The shortest secret word each choice allows is spread just as for random strike-outs of the same size: nothing about one or two filler letters helps.
